A clean conclusion is a coverage claim. Support it with the required coverage
records and concise citations to the contracts and source evidence checked.
State the result and material limitations in the designated summary or
assessment section. Explain the evidence for the conclusion, not your internal
deliberation or a fixed quota of imagined defects. Use this gate's partial or
incomplete route when required evidence is unavailable; finding no issue does
not establish that a test ran or an execution-only property passed. Retain
accepted Minor and IGNORE observations under the gate's existing verdict rules.
